title: SCA42: average percentage of primary school children absent, by year, county, DEIS status and school location
used_for: WP6 school-term attendance BOUND. Read carefully: SCA42 is the share of children absent for TWENTY DAYS OR MORE in the school year, which is chronic absence and not a daily absence rate. It therefore bounds the daily school-day attendance probability from below rather than setting it; the daily rate is [A] (calendar_events.py A-41).
